mapper.select: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Company, Address, City, State, Country, PostalCode, Phone, Fax, Email, SupportRepId FROM Customer ORDER BY CustomerId
SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Company, Address, City, State, Country, PostalCode, Phone, Fax, Email, SupportRepId FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE Customer SET FirstName = #{firstName}, LastName = #{lastName}, Company = #{company}, Address = #{address}, City = #{city}, State = #{state}, Country = #{country}, PostalCode = #{postalCode}, Phone = #{phone}, Fax = #{fax}, Email = #{email}, SupportRepId = #{supportRepId} WHERE CustomerId = #{customerId}
